Gujarat Cultural Association, IIT Kharagpur 
 
TO WHOMSOEVER IT MAY CONCERN 
This is to certify that Aryan Shah, having previously served as a Subhead of the Gujarat 
Cultural Association (GCA) at IIT Kharagpur during the 2025–26 academic session, will serve as 
the Design Head of the association for the 2026–27 academic session. 
In this position of responsibility, Aryan will play a key role in leading the planning, coordination,

and successful execution of various cultural events and initiatives aimed at promoting and 
celebrating Gujarati culture within the IIT Kharagpur community. Aryan will be expected to 
demonstrate exemplary leadership, commitment, organizational ability, and effective decision-
making throughout the tenure. 
As Design Head, Aryan will be responsible for overseeing the activities of the respective portfolio, 
coordinating with team members, managing responsibilities, ensuring the smooth execution of

assigned tasks, and contributing to the overall functioning and growth of the association. Aryan 
will also work closely with fellow office bearers and volunteers to ensure the successful conduct of 
the association's events and initiatives. 
We are confident that Aryan will continue to contribute significantly towards fostering a vibrant 
cultural environment at IIT Kharagpur and will uphold the values and objectives of the Gujarat

Cultural Association. We wish Aryan every success during the tenure and in all future academic, 
professional, and personal endeavours. 
Sincerely, 
 
 
 
 
 
 
                                                                             
                  
Prem Pastagia 
Executive Head 
Gujarat Cultural Association 
IIT Kharagpur 
 
Nandini Sanavda
